mechanism: Disulfiram inhibits CYP2D6 and CYP3A4, reducing amitriptyline metabolism and increasing tricyclic antidepressant levels, while both agents have additive CNS depressant effects.
action: Monitor for increased amitriptyline toxicity including anticholinergic effects, sedation, and arrhythmias; consider amitriptyline dose reduction or alternative antidepressant.
